# GLORIA

<!-- TODO: replace gloria.example.com with the production domain -->

> GLORIA is a next-generation digital platform built with modern web technologies — Vite, TypeScript, React 19 and Tailwind CSS. It showcases a premium product catalog with detailed specifications.

## Author

- [Hamed Sadim](https://github.com/HamedSadim1) — Full-Stack Web Developer specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript and C#.

## About

GLORIA demonstrates modern web development: instant builds, full TypeScript coverage, glassmorphism UI with neon accents, and zero tracking. The site contains a home page, an about page describing the tech stack, and a product catalog.

## Products

- [Accent Chair](https://gloria.example.com/contact/recZkNf2kwmdBcqd0): Premium seating, quality A+, 3 year warranty.
- [Albany Sectional](https://gloria.example.com/contact/recEHmzvupvT8ZONH): Living room sofa, quality A+, 5 year warranty.
- [Albany Table](https://gloria.example.com/contact/rec5NBwZ5zCD9nfF0): Tables, quality A, 2 year warranty.
- [Armchair](https://gloria.example.com/contact/recd1jIVIEChmiwhe): Premium seating, quality A+, 3 year warranty.
- [Bar Stool](https://gloria.example.com/contact/recoM2MyHJGHLVi5l): Seating, quality B+, 1 year warranty.
